author: TeIq
content: Closed. Mechanical extract-and-merge per architect-skill 'When to skip' (refactor with no design choice). New polaris-backend/src/labeler/canonicalize.rs is the single source of truth for signature-canonical Label DAG-CBOR bytes; both producer (labeler/emitter.rs::encode_canonical) and consumer (ingest/upstream_labels.rs::encode_label_canonical) now thin-shim to it. Public CanonicalizeError type kept opaque so each caller converts to its own typed error (EmitterError::Encode / HandleError::CanonicalEncode). 2/2 new canonicalize tests pass (encode_is_deterministic, encode_omits_sig_field). 8/8 emitter regression tests pass. Build + clippy + fmt clean.
